entries.query_str: what time is 23:59 AoE march 31 in eastern time
entries.answer: **Anywhere on Earth (AoE) is UTC−12.** So 23:59 AoE on March 31 is 11:59 UTC on **April 1**, which is **7:59 AM EDT on April 1** (Eastern Daylight Time, UTC−4, is in effect in late March) [1][2]. You have until tomorrow morning Eastern time.

sources.name: Anywhere on Earth (AoE) — explanation
sources.snippet: AoE is UTC−12, used for academic deadlines.

sources.name: Eastern Daylight Time
sources.snippet: EDT is UTC−4 from March to November.
